item.title: James Gray Says He’s “Dying” To Make An ‘Ad Astra’ Director’s Cut & Has Had Conversations With The Criterion Collection
item.description: Seven years after the release of “ Ad Astra ,” filmmaker James Gray remains eager to revisit his ambitious science-fiction drama starring Brad Pitt . While a director’s cut has yet to materialize, Gray has had conversations with the Criterion Collection about the possibility, though financial considerations and other complications continue to stand in the way. Speaking to The Playlist at the Marrakech International Film Festival, where he was presenting his latest film, “ Paper Tiger ,” Gray said he wants to return to the 2019 space odyssey when asked whether audiences might eventually see a director’s cut. Continue reading James Gray Says He’s “Dying” To Make An ‘Ad Astra’ Director’s Cut & Has Had Conversations With The Criterion Collection at The Playlist.
